change.summary: Scope the normal release/rollback unresolved-outcome guard to the current lease generation and exact fencing token, so an expired generation's quarantined queued/indeterminate occurrence cannot deadlock a successor terminal transition.
invariants: Full historical event and outbox chains are still verified before terminalization.
Only events matching the active handle generation and exact fencing token participate in the unresolved-state FSM.
Queued or Indeterminate occurrences in the current generation reject release and rollback before any lease row is appended.
After current-generation settlement, a successor can release despite unresolved rows quarantined by explicit expiry in an older generation.
The old occurrence remains fenced and cannot be rewritten by the successor; expiry remains the separate timeout path.
